title: Market’s Momentum Darlings Resurface as Optical Stocks Take Off
summary: One of the stock market’s favorite momentum plays from earlier this year is re-emerging as rising confidence in artificial intelligence spending sends the shares of optical component makers soaring again.

title: A Favorite Carry Trade Gets a Dose of Brazil Election Jitters
summary: Election worries are starting to seep into Brazilian markets, prompting some investors to pare exposure to one of this year’s most rewarding carry trades as they brace for a bumpier ride into the October presidential vote.

title: Stocks, Bonds Rise as Tame CPI Curbs Fed-Hike Bets: Markets Wrap
summary: An in-line inflation reading spurred gains in both stocks and bonds, easing concern about imminent Federal Reserve interest-rate increases despite elevated oil prices.

title: AI Earnings Boost Stock Futures; CPI Data Looms | Bloomberg Brief 08/12/2026
summary: CoreWeave and Super Micro push US stock futures higher as strong forecasts reinvigorate AI trade. Markets await key CPI data for a read on inflation. The IEA raises concerns about global oil inventories as the US and Iran harden their stances on the Strait of Hormuz. Andrew Hollenhorst of Citi looks ahead to the CPI data and its impact on the Fed's policy discussion. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Citi's Hollenhorst Weighs Oil Against Domestic Economy
summary: Andrew Hollenhorst, chief US economist at Citi, joins Bloomberg's Vonnie Quinn on "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss inflation and its potential to influence market expectations due to recent trends in price and labor data.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Russia Daily Oil Output Almost Million Barrels Below OPEC+ Quota
summary: Russia’s crude-only production lagged behind its OPEC+ quota by almost a million barrels a day in July as Ukraine attacked the nation’s oil infrastructure almost daily.

title: US Stock Futures Rise After ‘Bang-In-Line’ Inflation Data
summary: US stock futures extended gains after inflation data came in line with expectations, easing pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates and clearing the way for an earnings-led tech rally to continue.

title: 'Teflon' Inflation Won't Stick, JPMorgan's Kelly Says
summary: David Kelly, JPMorgan Asset Management's chief global strategist, sees a disinflation trend in the US stemming from lower tariff costs and oil eventually flowing out of the Strait of Hormuz. Speaking on "Bloomberg Surveillance," Kelly also says the Federal Reserve is on the wrong track signaling that they are going to communicate less. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Black Sea Oil Tanker Rates Surge to Record on Drones Barrage
summary: Freight costs for oil tankers shipping crude from the Black Sea to the Mediterranean have risen to a record after a flurry of drone attacks, driving down prices for Kazakhstan’s main CPC export grade.

title: US July Core CPI Rises 0.2%, Easing Pressure on Fed
summary: The US consumer price index rose by 0.2% which was bang in line with forecasts. Prices rose by 2.5% from a year earlier, matching the slowest pace since March 2021. Energy, gas and grocery prices all fell on the month. This likely eases pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates. Michael McKee reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Gold Rallies as Tame US Inflation Report Calms Rate Hike Fears
summary: Gold extended gains above $4,400 an ounce as US inflation data matched expectations, easing traders’ oncerns about imminent Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes despite elevated oil prices.

title: Bitwise Cuts 14% of Jobs With Crypto Industry Under Pressure
summary: Crypto firm Bitwise Asset Management Inc. has let go about 14% of its workforce during a prolonged slump in digital-asset prices.

title: New York City’s Five Pensions Gain 13% on Surging US Stocks
summary: New York City’s five pensions beat their investment target over the past fiscal year, propelled by a record-breaking US stock market.

title: Bond Traders Keep Cointoss Wager on September Fed Hike Post-CPI
summary: Traders held on to their hedges that Federal Reserve officials could raise interest rates at their next meeting in September, pricing in a roughly 50% chance of a move after a tame reading of US inflation.

title: Why Romantasy May Soon Be a Billion-Dollar Business
summary: Romantasy has grown from a BookTok-driven obsession to a nearly billion-dollar business, powered by a largely female fandom scooping up special editions, merchandise, event tickets, audiobooks and more. The genre's rise is reshaping publishing and drawing retailers, creators and now Hollywood into one of the book industry’s most powerful new markets. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Real Estate Fund Set to Lose Boston Life Science Investment
summary: A small US commercial real estate fund run by Deutsche Finance Group, the asset manager tied to many of the soured deals at German pension fund BVK, plans to file for insolvency after its investment in a Boston life sciences complex soured.

title: Hormuz Closure Helps Emerging-Market Company Bonds Beat US Peers
summary: The average borrowing cost of emerging-market companies has fallen to the lowest level since January relative to US corporates as global bond investors’ diversification into higher-yielding assets drives an outperformance.

title: China Revives Free-Trade Zone Bond Market After Crackdown
summary: The Shanghai free-trade zone’s bond market has its first new offering from a nonfinancial firm since Chinese authorities clamped down on excessive borrowing by local governments in late 2023.

title: Yardeni Says He Hasn't Been Bullish Enough on Earnings
summary: Ed Yardeni, president of Yardeni Research, says earnings are driving the markets higher. He talks about raising his year-end forecast for the S&P 500 from 8,250 to 8,400. He also talks about the artificial intelligence trade "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Potential ‘Peak Earnings’ Set the Stage for Disappointing Stocks
summary: The latest reason to worry about the stock market is quite the doozy: Earnings growth has been too strong.
